rules.chronology: A detected grammar feature is allowed only when an evidence-backed introduction point for the same textbook is at or before the passage subunit. Earlier grade learning carries forward; future units never authorize earlier passages.
rules.morphology: Known vocabulary base forms do not authorize an inflected form unless the form also passes grammar chronology.
rules.existingFlags: Per-unit audit flags, grammar labels, or previous PASS reports are not sufficient evidence for this final gate.
rules.passCondition: Every detected feature occurrence in all 168 passages and A/B English fields must resolve to an introduction point at or before the exact section; unresolved or future occurrences fail closed.

next: Populate introductionEvidence from textbook/subunit evidence, rerun the 168-passage candidate detector, resolve every occurrence against exact section order, and keep finalPass=false until unresolvedOccurrences=0 and futureGrammarLeak=0.
